description: Sweet-savory braised chicken with glass noodles from Andong.

steps.title: Prep the chicken
steps.description: Rinse chicken thighs and drumsticks under cold water. Pat dry with paper towel. Score the joints with a knife so the seasoning penetrates deeply.

steps.title: Soak the noodles
steps.description: Soak glass noodles in cold water for 20 minutes until softened. Drain and set aside.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.description: Cut potato and carrot into bite-sized chunks. Slice onion into thick strips. Cut green onion diagonally into 5cm pieces.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.description: In a bowl mix: soy sauce (5 tbsp), sugar (2 tbsp), minced garlic (4 cloves), black pepper (pinch), water (200ml). Stir until sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Braise the chicken
steps.description: Place chicken in a wide pan. Pour sauce over. Cover with lid and cook on medium heat for 15 minutes, turning chicken halfway through.

steps.title: Add vegetables
steps.description: Add potato, carrot, and onion. Cook uncovered on medium-low for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally until sauce reduces and coats everything.

steps.title: Add noodles & finish
steps.description: Add drained glass noodles and green onion. Cook 5 more minutes until noodles turn translucent. Drizzle sesame oil. Serve hot.

description: Fiery grilled chicken drenched in an ultra-spicy sauce.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.description: Mix chicken with all sauce ingredients. Marinate 30 minutes.

steps.title: Grill
steps.description: Grill or pan-fry chicken over medium-high heat until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Top with green onion and melted cheese if desired.

description: Sweet and savory marinated beef that's perfect with rice.

steps.title: Prepare the vegetables
steps.description: Slice the onion and green onion thinly.

steps.title: Marinate the beef
steps.description: Mix beef with soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and sesame oil. Marinate for at least 15 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Stir-fry the beef and onion over medium-high heat until fully cooked.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds. Enjoy with rice.

steps.description: Boil ribs briefly, then drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add clean ribs to a large pot with water, garlic, and onion. Simmer for 1 hour until tender.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.description: Season with salt. Serve in a bowl with green onion and a drizzle of sesame oil.

description: Rich pork bone soup with potatoes and greens.

steps.title: Parboil bones
steps.description: Boil pork bones briefly, then drain and rinse well.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Add clean bones to 6 cups of water with garlic. Boil 30 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Add gochugaru, doenjang, and potatoes. Simmer 20 more minutes until potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add greens, drizzle perilla oil, garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.

description: Bold fiery stew built on gochujang with pork and vegetables.

steps.title: Sauté pork
steps.description: Stir-fry pork with garlic and gochujang.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add 2 cups water, potato, and zucchini. Simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add tofu and mushroom. Cook 5 more minutes. Garnish with green onion.

description: Korean hangover soup with bean sprouts and dried cabbage.

steps.title: Make beef broth
steps.description: Boil beef until tender. Reserve broth. Slice beef.

steps.title: Add vegetables
steps.description: Add bean sprouts, doenjang, gochugaru, garlic, and soy sauce to broth. Simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add beef back. Garnish with green onion. Add egg if desired.

description: Soybean paste stew with fresh seafood and tofu.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Dissolve doenjang in anchovy broth with garlic.

steps.title: Add ingredients
steps.description: Add zucchini, seafood, and tofu. Simmer 12 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Garnish with green onion.

description: Soft tofu stew loaded with fresh seafood.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.description: Sauté garlic and gochugaru in sesame oil.

steps.title: Add seafood
steps.description: Add seafood and stir-fry briefly. Add 2 cups water and soy sauce.

steps.title: Add tofu
steps.description: Gently add soft tofu. Simmer 5 minutes. Crack egg in. Garnish and serve.

description: Light kimchi soup — simpler and brothier than kimchi jjigae.

steps.title: Simmer kimchi
steps.description: Add kimchi and garlic to 3 cups water. Bring to boil, simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add tofu
steps.description: Add tofu and soy sauce. Cook 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Drizzle sesame oil. Garnish with green onion.

description: A classic comfort stew that never gets old.

steps.title: Sauté the pork
steps.description: Stir-fry pork in a pot until lightly browned.

steps.title: Add kimchi
steps.description: Add kimchi and gochugaru. Stir-fry together for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add 2 cups of water and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Add tofu and serve
steps.description: Add cubed tofu and simmer for 5 more minutes. Garnish with green onion.

description: A nostalgic twist on kimchi jjigae with savory Spam.

steps.title: Brown the Spam
steps.description: Cut Spam into cubes and lightly fry until golden.

steps.title: Add kimchi
steps.description: Add kimchi and gochugaru to the pan. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add 2 cups water and soy sauce. Bring to a boil and simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add tofu and simmer 5 more minutes. Top with green onion.

description: Soft tofu stew with tangy kimchi for extra depth.

steps.title: Cook
steps.description: Sauté kimchi, garlic, and pork. Add water and soy sauce.

steps.title: Add tofu
steps.description: Add tofu and simmer 5 minutes. Add egg. Garnish with green onion.

description: Rich oxtail bone broth soup, slow-simmered for hours.

steps.title: Blanch oxtail
steps.description: Boil oxtail briefly, rinse thoroughly.

steps.title: Slow simmer
steps.description: Cover with fresh water, add garlic and onion. Simmer 2.5-3 hours.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Season with salt. Garnish with green onion. Serve with rice.

description: Creamy ground soybean stew with kimchi.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.description: Sauté pork, garlic, and kimchi with sesame oil.

steps.title: Add soybean pulp
steps.description: Add soybean pulp and 1 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes stirring often.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Add soy sauce. Garnish with green onion.

description: Korean seaweed soup — traditionally eaten on birthdays.

steps.title: Soak seaweed
steps.description: Soak 30g dried seaweed in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain and cut into pieces.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.description: Sauté beef strips in sesame oil. Add seaweed and soy sauce and stir-fry for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add 4 cups water and garlic. Simmer for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Season with salt. Garnish with green onion.

description: Whole chicken stuffed with rice and ginseng, simmered to perfection.

steps.title: Stuff chicken
steps.description: Stuff chicken cavity with rice, garlic, and ginseng.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Place in pot, cover with water. Simmer 1 hour until chicken is very tender.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.description: Season broth with salt. Serve whole chicken in the broth with green onion.

description: Clear radish and beef soup — clean, comforting, everyday Korean.

steps.title: Sauté beef
steps.description: Sauté beef with sesame oil and soy sauce for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add radish
steps.description: Add cubed radish (200g) and 4 cups water. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Simmer 20 minutes until radish is tender and translucent.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Add garlic, season with salt. Garnish with green onion.

description: Silky soft tofu stew with a spicy, savory broth.

steps.title: Sauté aromatics
steps.description: Sauté garlic and gochugaru in sesame oil for 1 minute.

steps.title: Add broth
steps.description: Add 1.5 cups of water (or anchovy broth) and soy sauce. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Add tofu
steps.description: Gently spoon in soft tofu. Simmer for 5 minutes without stirring too much.

steps.title: Add egg and serve
steps.description: Crack an egg directly into the stew. Cook for 1–2 minutes. Garnish with green onion.

description: Fiery shredded beef soup with bean sprouts.

steps.title: Boil beef
steps.description: Boil beef until tender, about 40 minutes. Reserve broth. Shred beef.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.description: Sauté gochugaru and garlic in sesame oil. Add shredded beef.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.description: Add beef broth, bean sprouts, and soy sauce. Simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add green onion. Adjust seasoning. Serve hot with rice.

description: Crispy Korean fried chicken without the sauce.

steps.title: Season chicken
steps.description: Season chicken with salt and garlic. Rest 15 minutes.

steps.title: Coat and fry
steps.description: Coat in starch and fry until golden and crispy, about 12 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

description: Fish cake skewers simmered in a savory broth — a beloved street food.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Bring anchovy broth to boil with garlic and soy sauce.

steps.title: Add fish cakes
steps.description: Thread fish cakes on skewers and simmer in broth 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with green onion. Serve with broth in a cup.

description: Pan-fried Korean dumplings — crispy on the bottom, juicy inside.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.description: Mix pork, crumbled tofu, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and green onion.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.description: Place filling in wrappers, fold and seal edges.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.description: Fry in oiled pan until bottom is golden. Add 1/4 cup water, cover and steam 5 minutes.

description: Sweet Korean pancakes filled with brown sugar and cinnamon.

steps.title: Make dough
steps.description: Mix 2 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 3/4 cup warm water. Rest 1 hour.

steps.title: Make filling
steps.description: Mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and sesame seeds.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.description: Flatten dough, add filling, seal. Pan-fry until golden, pressing flat with spatula.

description: Spicy stir-fried blood sausage with vegetables.

steps.title: Slice soondae
steps.description: Slice soondae into bite-sized pieces.

steps.title: Stir-fry
steps.description: Stir-fry garlic and onion. Add soondae, gochujang, gochugaru, and soy sauce.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Toss with green onion and sesame oil.

description: The ultimate Korean street food combo: tteokbokki with soondae.

steps.title: Make sauce
steps.description: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, sugar, and soy sauce with 2 cups water.

steps.title: Cook rice cakes
steps.description: Boil rice cakes in sauce for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add soondae
steps.description: Add soondae and fish cake. Cook 3 more minutes. Garnish with green onion.

description: Spicy, chewy rice cakes in a sweet and fiery gochujang sauce.

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.description: Mix gochujang, gochugaru, sugar, and soy sauce with 2 cups of water in a pan.

steps.title: Cook the rice cakes
steps.description: Bring sauce to a boil. Add rice cakes and cook on medium heat for 10–15 minutes, stirring often.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Once sauce thickens and coats the rice cakes, remove from heat. Garnish with green onion.

description: Korean street food fritters — vegetables and fish cake in crispy batter.

steps.title: Make batter
steps.description: Mix 1 cup flour, 1 egg, 3/4 cup cold water, and salt.

steps.title: Coat and fry
steps.description: Dip vegetables and fish cake in batter. Deep or shallow fry until golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Drain on paper towel. Serve with soy sauce dip.

description: Blanched broccoli tossed in a garlicky soy dressing.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.description: Blanch broccoli florets for 2 minutes. Drain and cool.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Mix with soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with sesame seeds.

description: Crispy chive pancakes — simple and satisfying.

steps.title: Make batter
steps.description: Mix 1/2 cup flour, eggs, 1/2 cup water, and salt. Add chopped chives.

steps.title: Pan-fry
steps.description: Cook in oiled pan over medium-high heat until golden on both sides.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Serve with soy sauce dip.

description: Quick cabbage salad with doenjang dressing.

steps.title: Shred cabbage
steps.description: Shred cabbage thinly. Blanch briefly or eat raw.

steps.title: Mix dressing
steps.description: Mix doenjang, sesame oil, garlic, and vinegar.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.description: Toss cabbage with dressing. Garnish with sesame seeds.

description: Simple potato soup in a light anchovy broth.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Bring anchovy broth to boil. Dissolve doenjang with garlic.

steps.title: Add potato
steps.description: Add cubed potato. Simmer 12 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Season with salt. Garnish with green onion and sesame oil.

description: Zucchini seasoned with doenjang — nutty and savory.

steps.title: Slice zucchini
steps.description: Slice zucchini into half-moons. Sauté in a little oil until soft.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Mix with doenjang, sesame oil, and garlic.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.

description: Traditional homemade napa cabbage kimchi.

steps.title: Salt cabbage
steps.description: Quarter cabbage and salt between leaves. Let sit 2 hours, turning occasionally. Rinse and drain.

steps.title: Make paste
steps.description: Mix gochugaru, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, and sugar into a paste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.description: Toss cabbage and green onion with paste, coating every leaf.

steps.title: Ferment
steps.description: Pack into jar. Leave at room temperature 1-2 days, then refrigerate.

description: Light noodle and vegetable bowl seasoned with soy and sesame.

steps.title: Cook noodles and veg
steps.description: Cook glass noodles 3 minutes, drain. Blanch spinach and sprouts separately.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Toss everything with soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Plate and garnish with sesame seeds.

description: Simple radish and doenjang soup.

steps.title: Make broth
steps.description: Bring anchovy broth to boil. Dissolve doenjang.

steps.title: Add radish
steps.description: Add cubed radish and garlic. Simmer 12 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.description: Add tofu if using. Garnish with green onion.

description: Cold cucumber salad with a tangy-sweet dressing.

steps.title: Prep cucumber
steps.description: Slice cucumber thinly. Salt and let sit 5 minutes. Squeeze out moisture.

steps.title: Season
steps.description: Mix with vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, and gochugaru.

steps.title: Serve
steps.description: Garnish with sesame seeds. Serve immediately chilled.
